description: This file defines a singleton object 'Validation' that provides validation methods for user input fields such as email, password, and confirm password, including regex-based email validation and basic password checks.

methods.name: emailError
methods.description: Validates the email string; returns error message if invalid or null if valid.

methods.name: passwordError
methods.description: Validates the password string; returns error message if invalid or null if valid.

methods.name: confirmPasswordError
methods.description: Checks if the confirmation password matches the original; returns error message if not or null if valid.
